verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents an Insights Agent that gives proactive recommendations and conversational insights from a user's own incident, service and team analytics. AI Orchestrations analyze historical events to recommend rules, and PagerDuty Advance generates AI summaries of incidents and post-incident reviews. All of these run inside the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and deeper docs on which plans include these features and their limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: delivers proactive recommendations and on-demand conversational insights based on your Incidents, Services, and Teams analytics
automatically analyze historical events and incidents and surface recommended rules that reduce noise, improve MTTR, and accelerate automation setup
generative AI for summarizing key information about an incident
PagerDuty Advance is a set of generative and agentic AI capabilities embedded across the PagerDuty Operations Cloud
